in_marathi.name: Sarangdhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarangdhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sarangdhar is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'saranga', which means 'love' or 'affection'. The name is associated with Lord Krishna, who is known to have immense love and compassion towards his devotees. Sarangdhar symbolizes the love and care that a father should have for his child.
